feats.title: Baalzebul's Desperate Gambit
feats.description: When you first become bloodied in an encounter, you can roll a saving throw, with a bonus equal to the number of enemies adjacent to you. If you succeed, spend a healing surge. If you fail, you lose a healing surge.

feats.title: Bel's Impending Victory
feats.description: When you hit a bloodied enemy, your allies gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls against the target until the start of your next turn.

feats.title: Blood of Levistus
feats.description: You gain resistance to cold equal to 5 + one-half your level. You gain a +3 feat bonus to damage rolls with attacks that have the cold keyword.

feats.title: Fiery Rebuke
feats.description: When you use the Infernal Wrath power, the target takes 5 extra fire damage.

feats.title: Hellfire of Mephistopheles
feats.description: Each time you hit an enemy that has fire resistance, after resolving the attack, reduce the value of the resistance by 5 until the end of the encounter.

feats.title: Mammon's Theft of Health
feats.description: When you use your Second Wind, you can choose for an ally within 5 squares of you to lose a healing surge. If you do, you regain extra hit points equal to your healing surge value.
